'''January 2001 Colorado Springs tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Colorado Springs, CO on 27 January 2001. [[Van Melancon]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1712">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territoryd1712/ ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territory], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territoryd1712/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Colorado Springs, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Van Melancon]]
